d: Open country with casino on one side to enjoy the hunting of the Aironi, and on the other a hill, where you can see, that Don Quixote and Sancio. The Duke, La Duchess, Altisidora, and Grullo with followers of Falconieri.
The Duke, The Duchess, Altisidora, Don Alvaro, and Laurindo.

Courtyard with colonnade around, and a two-armed staircase in the middle, underneath which a large door, from which you can discover the countryside in the distance, and where Don Quixote and Sancho come, the one on horseback, and the other in the mare. The duke, La Duchess, Altisidora, Don Alvaro, Don Quixote, and Sancio. Damigelle, who sprinkle Don Quixote with smelly waters, and Soldatesche deployed, who present him with the weapons; awesome with trumpets, tympanes, and drums, hunting horns, etc. Chorus of Popolo.
The Duke, the Duchess, the Altisidora, Don Quixote, and Doralba, who did not see Don Quixote speak to the Duke.
Don Alvaro in progress, that Altisidora wants to leave the stop.
The Duke, the Duchess, the Altisidora, Don Quixote, and Sancio, followed by Hunters, who carry in triumph a head of wild boar killed by Don Quixote.
It hears amazing military instruments, which constitute a dark march, and at the same time it sees the wood lit for every part; Cricket in satire dress, and sayings.

Doralba, and Don Alvaro in a triumphal chariot representing the one Dulcinea, and the other Merlin Ancantator. Cricket with Satiri's sequel, and sayings. In the time that comes the chariot, follows a gentle harmony of pipers, flutes, oboe, etc.
It is heard a fluble symphony of pipers, flutes, oboe, and a forgotten drum. Laurindo appearing the Countess Dolorida, followed by Matron, and sayings.
It turns the chariot into a horse. The Duke, The Duchess, Altisidora, Laurindo, Don Quixote, Sancho, and Grullo.
The Duke, The Duchess, Altisidora, Don Quixote, and Sancho. The horse disappears.
Inside room of Don Quixote. Don Quixote, and Sancho in governor's dress, sitting.
Don Quixote, and then Donna Rodrigues.
Open country with view of the castle on one side, and on the other a ditch, which corresponds in a cave. Don Quixote, and Sancio in the ditch.
Don Alvaro with Soldiers, and sayings.
Courtyard for use of fence for the dagger and railings around beautifully adorned. The Duke, The Duchess, Laurindo, and Sancio.
Don Quixote, Don Alvaro armed with lowered visor, Altisidora, Doralba covered with veil, and sayings.
Grullo, a squire of the ten knights, and sayings.
